name: Haramase Gakuen Royal ~Shojo-tachi no Seishi Soudatsusen~
original_name: 孕ませ学園ロワイヤル～処女たちの精子争奪戦～
source:
One day, while I was spending my peaceful days as an average NEET, I was approached by two pretty girls I've never seen before, "Reia'' and "Runa''.

"We'll give you our virginity, so give us your seed and impregnate us, now.'', they said and proceeded to force themselves on me.

As they explained later, it seems that I am the illegitimate son of the head of a famous conglomerate. Having had my virginity forcibly taken by these two, I am now forced to live at a prestigious girls' school, where my childhood friend Yurika, whom I have a crush on, also happened to transfer to.

And so, an all-school battle begins where the girls fight over who gets to bear my child! What's going to happen to me in this crazy school impregnation life?
translation:
某天，我这个平凡的家里蹲正过着安稳日子，两名从未见过的美少女突然找上门来。她们名叫日镜玲亚与日镜瑠奈。

“把处女之身献给你，所以现在就给我们种子，让我们怀孕。”

话音刚落，两人便强行扑了上来。

后来她们解释说，我似乎是某个著名财阀掌门人的私生子。被两人强行夺走童贞后，我又被迫住进一所名门女校，而自己暗恋的青梅竹马朱火优里香也恰好转学到这里。

就这样，一场席卷全校的大战拉开帷幕，女孩们争夺着由谁怀上我的孩子！这场疯狂的学园播种生活，究竟会把我带向何方？
